name: STL Scale Inspector
metaTitle: STL Scale Inspector | Check Scale Before You Slice | No Upload | STLACCESS
shortDescription: Check what size an STL will actually print at. Use the scale math, or drop in a file to read its real millimetre and inch dimensions locally.
description: The tool I use before every print. Select the scale your STL was designed for, pick the scale you need, and choose between eye-level or top-of-head measurement. You can also drop an STL into the local file inspector to read its exact bounding box in millimetres and inches, flag an inches-vs-millimetres mismatch, and calculate the percentage needed to reach a target height. Supports 16 tabletop scales and runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.
features: Local STL dimension and unit inspection
Eye Level and Top of Head measurement

name: Miniature Size Chart
shortDescription: Every conversion percentage I've verified for scaling 3D printed miniatures, all in one searchable list. Print-tested on FDM.
description: Every conversion percentage I have verified, all on a single page. Covers 28mm, 32mm, 35mm, 40mm, 75mm, 1:35, 1:48, 1:56, 1:72, and 1:100 scales. Each entry shows the math, the scale baselines, and FDM print notes. You can jump straight to the calculator from any conversion. I update these when the community catches something wrong.
features: Full math breakdown for each entry

name: Filament Cost Calculator

name: Scale Reference Bar Generator
metaTitle: STL Scale Reference Bar Generator — Calibration Bar for Lychee & Chitubox | STLACCESS
shortDescription: Generate a printable ruler bar at any tabletop scale and import it into Lychee or Chitubox to measure unknown STLs. Download the STL right in your browser.

Import it next to any model of unknown scale, measure the model against the ruler in your slicer, and you instantly know what percentage to type in. Generated in your browser — nothing uploaded.

name: Filament Density Calculator
metaTitle: Filament Density & Weight-to-Volume Estimator — Grams from Volume | STLACCESS
shortDescription: Enter dimensions or a volume, pick a material, and get the weight in grams before you open your slicer. PLA, PETG, ABS, resin, and more.
description: A pre-slice planning calculator. Type the dimensions of a solid or hollow shape — or the volume straight from your slicer — choose a material, and the tool multiplies volume by density to give you the weight in grams, prints per spool, and a print-time baseline. Hollow prints account for wall thickness and infill, so the number reflects what actually comes off the build plate. Runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.
features: Box, cylinder, sphere, and tube shapes
Hollow shell math with wall thickness and infill
Direct volume input in cm³ or mL
Prints per spool and cost estimate
Print time baseline by quality preset

name: EU Import & Landed Cost Calculator
h1: EU 3D Printing Import & Landed Cost Calculator
metaTitle: EU 3D Printing Import & Landed Cost Calculator — €3 Customs Duty + VAT | STLACCESS
shortDescription: The true landed cost in EUR for 3D printing supplies shipped into the EU — item price, shipping, the €3 per-item customs duty, and import VAT for your country.
description: Sticker prices on foreign webshops no longer tell the whole story. Since 1 July 2026 the EU charges a €3 customs duty per item on parcels valued up to €150, and import VAT applies to the item price, shipping, and duty combined. Enter what you are buying, how many distinct product categories are in the box, and your country's VAT rate — the calculator gives you the full landed cost in EUR instantly. Built for EU makers ordering filaments, nozzles, heater blocks, and printer parts from outside the EU. Runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.
features: €3 flat customs duty per item category
Import VAT for all 27 EU member states
Correct VAT base: item + shipping + duty
Over-€150 orders with custom duty rate
No account, no cookies — nothing uploaded

name: Resin Shrinkage Calculator
metaTitle: 3D Resin Shrinkage Calculator | Dimensional Tolerance Math | STLACCESS
shortDescription: Calculate exact dimensional scaling compensation for resin and FDM 3D printing. Prevent shrinkage distortion and ensure precise part-to-part fitting.
description: When 3D printing engineering components or tight-tolerance miniatures, material cooling and UV curing cause physical parts to shrink. This interactive 3D math tool calculates your exact dimensional compensation percentage to counteract volumetric shrinkage in your slicer. Thirteen material presets, separate XY and Z shrink rates, and a measured-coupon mode that back-solves your real shrink factor from caliper readings. Runs entirely in your browser — no uploads, no accounts, no cookies.
features: Fit clearance for press and slide fits

name: Layer Resolution & Angle Calculator

metaTitle: 3D Layer Resolution & Angle Calculator | Print Math | STLACCESS
shortDescription: Calculate optimal layer height, Z-axis resolution, and surface stair-stepping angles for FDM and resin 3D printing precision.
description: Surface smoothness on curved 3D prints is governed by trigonometric layer-step math. Step riser, step tread, worst-case faceting at 45°, sanding estimates, print-time tradeoffs, and the maximum unsupported overhang for seven materials.
